name: app-check-client-on-token-changed
description: Debug mode only (registered debug token): onTokenChanged with a listener function and with an observer object, registered before the first getToken. Counts are read 300 ms after each step: after the first get, after a second get, after a forced refresh, after two getLimitedUseToken calls, and after unsubscribing and forcing again; argument key sets; which token each call carried; and a listener registered after a token exists (synchronously and within 500 ms).
